questions.explanation: Oxygen is the terminal electron acceptor. It accepts electrons and protons to form water, and without this final acceptor, electron flow through the chain cannot continue normally.

questions.explanation: Fermentation does not replace glycolysis; it regenerates NAD+ so glycolysis can keep running. It uses no oxygen as a terminal electron acceptor and produces much less ATP per glucose than aerobic respiration.
